tour.body1: Home shows the due date, overall progress and your team. Choose a language now; you can switch any time from the top right.
tour.body2: You decide who needs focused attention first. There is no quota; base it on business need.
tour.body3: Answer one question at a time; about 15 minutes or less per key talent. If unsure, open the lightbulb next to the question for criteria and examples.
tour.body4: Your work saves automatically, so you can finish over several sittings. Submit when done, then finalize with your HRBP.
